text: {"lessons":["My account rose about 21% from Period 1 to Period 10 while I traded in only two months. I won’t trade just because it’s time to review the account.","I held through the dip in Period 4, and my account recovered the next month. I’ll revisit why I own a stock before selling in response to a short-term decline.","I trimmed B and E after large gains, but a gain over my purchase price doesn’t tell me whether to sell. Next time I’ll weigh the stock’s current prospects and how much of my portfolio it represents."]}
